plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Profiles for Claude Code sittings: one resolved configuration per session, offered to the plugins that depend on it, and a doctor that checks the setup.

plugins.name: decisions
plugins.description: Verbs over one sectioned DECISIONS.md per repo: show, find, new, ask, answer and render, plus doctor and backlog. A repo owns its ledger; the plugin carries no data.

plugins.name: respeak
plugins.description: A narrator for agent work: a translator agent and one skill render human-facing narratives in ELI5, BLUF or technical mode, in a layered tone.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Queued packet runs, one child per worktree: resume, status, plan, gate, report and doctor over the relay binary, plus the guards: one commit per act, no remote writes.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: See every agent on this Mac, run a session's mechanical subagents on a local model through a loopback router, and write a repo's records from a hand-back.
